summary: News Corp filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to disclose daily repurchase program transactions provided to the ASX. The company has a $1 billion aggregate authorization for buybacks of Class A and Class B common stock. No specific price, terms, or premium were given; disclosures are routine and forward-looking statements about market conditions. The filing is a compliance-update on an ongoing program, not a new special situation event.
